eyebrow: Data Visualization & Exploratory Data Analysis · Chapter 2
subtitle: Lesson 5 · Visualization in Python

code:
# pyplot style: quick, implicit
plt.plot(x, y)
plt.title("Monthly revenue")

# object-oriented style: explicit
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(x, y)
ax.set_title("Monthly revenue")
caption: Axes methods use set_title, set_xlabel, set_ylabel.

code:
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.2))
ax.plot(revenue.index, revenue.values,
        marker="o")
ax.set_title("Monthly revenue")
ax.set_xlabel("Month")
ax.set_ylabel("Revenue ($ thousands)")
fig.autofmt_xdate()
fig.savefig("revenue.png", dpi=130)
caption: Illustrative monthly revenue, seeded.
